analysis_status: designed after the repaired current-state opportunity result was observed; robustness only, not confirmatory
question: Does the focal-response-excluded current-opportunity signal persist when an annual link must have at least 2 or at least 3 observed visits rather than any positive visit?
fixed_surface: Use the already frozen shared-species dyad rows from the annual Stage-1 table. Only the binary link-state threshold is changed; species presence and dyad eligibility are not re-estimated.

interpretation.allowed: robustness of the current-state opportunity association to excluding singleton and very-low-frequency links

claim_ceiling: Post-result frequency-threshold robustness only. Persistence at >=2 and >=3 observed visits shows that the repaired opportunity signal is not confined to singleton links, but it is not a detection model, causal analysis, true-absence analysis, decision-equivalence test, or routeability test.
